# Phygital+

> Phygital+ is an AI workspace with 30+ integrated tools for creative control across image generation, video production, and design applications.

Phygital+ serves creative professionals across multiple industries including e-commerce, agencies, interior design, marketing, and content creation. The platform integrates leading AI models like GPT-4o, FLUX, Kling, and Sora 2 to enable brand-consistent content production and design visualization.

## Key Topics

- Image Generation
- Video Generation
- AI Workspace
- Creative Tools
- Design Tools
- Brand Consistency
- Content Creation
- Multi-Model Platform
- FLUX
- Kling

- Sora 2
- Veo 3.1

- Content Production

## Core Platform

- [Take control of your AI results | Phygital+](https://phygital.plus): Phygital+ AI workspace with 30+ tools for creative control and content creation
- [Tools - Phygital+](https://phygital.plus/tools): Showcase of AI tools including book illustration, face editing, character maker

## Industry Solutions

- [AI for E-Commerce Design | Phygital+](https://phygital.plus/for-ecommerce): Phygital+ for e-commerce: product photos, banners, and lifestyle scenes
- [AI for Creative Agencies | Phygital+](https://phygital.plus/for-creative-agencies): Phygital+ for agencies: video, character creation, storyboarding, campaigns
- [AI for Interior Designers and architecture | Phygital+](https://phygital.plus/industry-interior-designers-and-architecture): Phygital+ for interior design: visualization, rendering, mockups, presentations
- [AI for Creative Agencies | Phygital+](https://phygital.plus/for-communication-design-and-marketing): Phygital+ for marketing: ad campaigns, branded content, product visualization
- [AI for Content Creators | Phygital+](https://phygital.plus/for-content-creators): Phygital+ for creators: video, images, character consistency, storyboards
